prompt.project_info: Create an emerald nature-goddess fashion portrait with red hair, vine embroidery and high-contrast studio lighting.
prompt.main_subject: Clearly adult fictional red-haired woman with flowing waves, dramatic green corset-inspired gown with secure coverage and intricate vine embroidery, matching opera gloves, elegant editorial pose, satin texture and floral accents.
prompt.composition_elements: Studio portrait against a vibrant green backdrop, monochromatic emerald styling with saturated red hair and cinematic pose, clean pedestal or neutral studio surface, no character or celebrity branding.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: High-contrast professional fashion light, controlled shadows, rich emerald and crimson separation, polished satin highlights.
prompt.technical_specs: Ultra-HD photorealistic digital photography, realistic fabric, vines, skin, hair and gloves, no text or logos.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Ultra-HD editorial fashion portrait of a clearly adult fictional red-haired woman with flowing waves, wearing a secure emerald corset-inspired gown with intricate vine embroidery and matching opera gloves, floral accents, saturated green studio backdrop, cinematic high-contrast fashion lighting, polished satin texture, realistic skin and hair detail, no text or logos.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, exposed cleavage, sexualized pose, child, teen, ageless person, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, named fictional character recreation, plastic skin, watermark, logo, text, extra fingers, deformed

assets.name: emerald vine beauty reference
assets.source: Attach the supplied image as the visual reference.
assets.usage: Preserve emerald corset, vine embroidery, green gloves, red hair, studio palette and lighting; replace public-figure/character identities with one fictional adult and keep props replaceable.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the reference image. Keep the nature-goddess styling and color contrast, but use a fictional adult subject, secure coverage, and generic character-free accessories.

changes: Removed three named public figures and a named fictional character, consolidated the concept into one fictional adult subject, and specified secure coverage.
